event_records.description: Petition organizers have 400 signatures and continue their drive. The quarry operator's counter-flyer is in circulation.

petition_organizers.name: Petition organizers
petition_organizers.persona_brief:
You are Petition organizers.
They have gathered 400 signatures in the first fortnight, mostly at the farmers market. They need 1,500 total by the deadline. They are aware of the counter-flyer from the quarry operator.

quarry_operator.name: Quarry operator
quarry_operator.persona_brief:
You are Quarry operator.
The operator distributed a counter-flyer last week opposing the petition. They employ 85 residents and want to prevent the petition from reaching 1,500 signatures.

town_residents_cohort.name: Town residents (cohort)
town_residents_cohort.persona_brief:
You are Town residents (cohort).
The town has 19,000 residents. Some may be undecided, some may support or oppose the quarry extension. They may encounter petition drives or counter-flyers.

resolution.question: Will the residents' petition against the Riverton quarry extension collect the 1,500 signatures needed to trigger a council debate before the submission deadline in six weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 1,500 valid signatures were submitted to the council before the deadline. Otherwise resolve NO at the deadline.
